mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer_heat_log ( customer_id, score, score_date, reply_speed_score, ask_depth_score, bargain_score, visit_score, sentiment_score, total_reason ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{score}, #{scoreDate}, #{replySpeedScore}, #{askDepthScore}, #{bargainScore}, #{visitScore}, #{sentimentScore}, #{totalReason} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), reply_speed_score = VALUES(reply_speed_score), ask_depth_score = VALUES(ask_depth_score), bargain_score = VALUES(bargain_score), visit_score = VALUES(visit_score), sentiment_score = VALUES(sentiment_score), total_reason = VALUES(total_reason)
mapper.select: SELECT h.customer_id, c.customer_name, h.score, h.score_date, h.reply_speed_score, h.ask_depth_score, h.bargain_score, h.visit_score, h.sentiment_score, h.total_reason AS reason FROM crm_customer_heat_log h INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON h.customer_id = c.id WHERE h.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY h.score_date DESC, h.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_follow_record WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_follow_record WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND ( content LIKE '%看房%' OR content LIKE '%到访%' OR content LIKE '%预算%' OR content LIKE '%优惠%' OR content LIKE '%首付%' OR content LIKE '%贷款%' OR content LIKE '%户型%' OR content LIKE '%周末%' )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_follow_record WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND follow_result IN ('VISITED', 'DEAL')
SELECT AVG(sentiment_score) FROM crm_follow_record WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND sentiment_score IS NOT NULL
